channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Claude Code now runs on Opus 5.5, which officially blocks recreations of specific existing games
item.description: Anthropic remotely pushed an undisableable hidden rule to Claude Code on Opus 5.5 barring replication of specific existing games and allowing only original work, existing genres or owned assets, though industry observers say the prompt-layer soft constraint is easily bypassed. (AIbase)

item.title: DeepSeek drops Super-agent: AI goes from waiting for assignments to finding its own work
item.description: DeepSeek Harness open-sourced a Super-agent prototype whose internal instance sniffs out and reproduces bugs in the background without being @-mentioned, using Router+Worker scheduling to break the human limit of watching 3 to 5 sessions at once. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT and Codex will share usage limits starting in December; Instant chat unaffected
item.description: Starting in December, OpenAI will share part of the usage allowance for ChatGPT Plus, Pro and Business plans with Codex, measured in tokens, with complex tasks consuming more while Instant chat remains unaffected. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI Announces Tougher ChatGPT Limits on Violent Content, With Account Bans for Repeated Dangerous Conversations
item.description: OpenAI will spend the coming weeks tightening ChatGPT's violence-related content limits, letting the system actively end conversations judged to persistently focus on violence or serious harm to others and potentially suspend or ban accounts terminated repeatedly. (AIbase)

item.title: xAI Grok officially supports Alipay and UnionPay, offering mainland China users 50% off their first month
item.description: xAI’s Grok now accepts Alipay and China UnionPay, offers subscriptions in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, and gives first-time subscribers 50% off the first month, with Alipay also usable for X Premium. (AIbase)

item.title: Chinese LLMs Lead Global Weekly API Call Volume for 27 Consecutive Weeks as OpenRouter Data Reveals Booming Domestic AI Ecosystem
item.description: OpenRouter data shows Chinese large models drew 99.55 trillion tokens of weekly calls, up 6.43% week over week and ahead of the U.S. for 27 straight weeks, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 ranking first. (AIbase)

item.title: Usage for Claude + ChatGPT 4.0 — Claude + ChatGPT limits on your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch
item.description: A "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA page is all that loads in place of the promised breakdown of Claude and ChatGPT 4.0 usage limits across Mac, iPhone, iPad and Watch. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Baidu Search AI API costs just 4.9 yuan per 1,000 calls, undercutting DeepSeek
item.description: Baidu's upgraded Search AI API costs 4.9 yuan per 1,000 calls during its promotion—below DeepSeek's search API—and its four-layer AI-native architecture lifts content credibility over 50%, with API, MCP and Skill access aimed at Agent developers. (InfoQ CN)

item.title: For the first time, Tokens are being listed as a standalone category on e-commerce platforms for Double 11, as AI compute goes on sale to the general public.
item.description: At Double Eleven, Token became a standalone category on multiple e-commerce platforms, with Su Guoqing in Xining, Qinghai buying bulk for video work—simple shots use less, complex scenes and action storyboards more—taking AI compute to mass retail. (AIbase)

item.title: telemetry.dev — Observability for AI agents
item.description: The telemetry.dev page titled "Observability for AI agents" returns only a "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA prompt, so readers get no actual information on AI agent observability. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Four AI giants team up on 'anti-crawling' standard: website owners get a unified opt-out switch
item.description: On November 1, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic agreed on a shared standard that lets publishers declare "no AI crawling" once in their existing robots.txt file, notifying all four companies at once, with Anthropic already adopting it and OpenAI planning rollout over the coming months. (AIbase)

item.title: Apollo economist says AI has "no economic payoff" for most businesses
item.description: Apollo economist argues that despite massive AI investment and widespread hype, corporate America outside the tech sector has seen zero financial payoff, highlighting the gap between AI spending and returns. (techcrunch.com)

item.title: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub — In-depth tutorials on LLMs, RAGs and real-world AI agent applications.
item.description: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub gathers in-depth LLM, RAG and real-world AI agent tutorials tiered from beginner to researcher, spanning single- and multi-component agentic workflows, fine-tuning and production deployment, plus a free 150+ lesson Data Science eBook. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: It’s not AI that reverses a proton’s charge
item.description: Proton CEO Andy Yen dismissed an engineer's request for a few days of penetration testing before shipping as "loser thinking" and tied AI use to employee retention, raising why security guardrails at a privacy company are treated as a burden. (blog.raed.dev)

item.title: Minecraft's AI agent colony fails to build a civilization, getting mired in bureaucracy instead
item.description: A Minecraft experiment in which AI agents attempted to build a civilization failed, with the agents bogged down in bureaucracy, in a test meant to offer insight into recent AI agent headlines. (www.tomshardware.com)

item.title: AI fan wikis riddled with errors are muddying the waters of games culture
item.description: AI fan wikis riddled with errors are muddying the waters of games culture

item.title: Microsoft AI chief draws a red line: AI shouldn't be conscious — and if it ever is, everyone hits pause
item.description: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman said in a Nov. 2 X post that current models are not conscious and should never be, drawing a red line: any consciousness signs in training should trigger an industry-wide pause until designs eliminate them. (AIbase)

item.title: China's AI inference data surpasses training for the first time, with daily token calls topping 175 trillion
item.description: China’s daily token calls exceeded 175 trillion by June 2026, up more than 1,000-fold from early 2024, and AI inference data volume surpassed training data for the first time, according to a CCID Research Institute report. (AIbase)

item.title: Li Jiaqi's livestream is selling Tokens too! AI compute and smart hardware make their Double 11 debut — Entertainment Editor
item.description: At 19:30 tonight, Li Jiaqi’s Tmall Double 11 livestream will list Token products for the first time, with Qwen Office CEO Chen Yusen appearing and three built-in Qwen Office devices—AI computer, AI recording card and desktop robot—on show. (AIbase)

item.title: Tesla's humanoid robot scores a major breakthrough: the production Optimus debuts an end-to-end large vision model, with movement fluidity on par with a real human
item.description: Tesla's mass-production Optimus is the first to use an end-to-end vision model sharing FSD's origins, dropping modular algorithms and relying solely on onboard stereo cameras to generate real-time full-body joint commands, with smooth motion in pushing and fine-grasping tests. (AIbase)
